_comment: Voice-assistant vocabulary. 'commands' are Vrui pipe-command tokens the assistant may issue (id | arguments | description). 'tools' and 'devices' give the LLM canonical names + spoken aliases to ground arguments on; the running app's live tool/device names are merged in at startup. Ported from the former entities.yaml + commands/*.yaml.

commands.name: reset view
commands.description: Reset the navigation view to the default position and orientation.

commands.name: save screenshot
commands.description: Save a screenshot of the current view to an image file.

commands.name: show message
commands.description: Show a text message to the user.

commands.name: save view
commands.description: Save the current viewpoint to a file.

commands.name: load view
commands.description: Load a viewpoint from a file.

commands.name: switch tool
commands.description: Bind or switch the interaction tool on an input device, e.g. put a tool in a hand or change which tool a controller holds. (Not a built-in Vrui command yet; resolves but does not execute.)

tools.name: Jedi Tool
tools.description: A glowing lightsaber blade for pointing out features in 3D.

tools.name: Laserpointer Tool
tools.description: A laser-pointer ray for indicating features.

tools.name: Flashlight Tool
tools.description: A virtual flashlight that lights up the scene.

tools.name: Measurement Tool
tools.description: Measures distances and positions in the environment.

tools.name: Clip Plane Tool
tools.description: Adds a clipping plane to cut away part of the scene.

tools.name: Six-Dof Dragging Tool
tools.description: Grab and move objects with six degrees of freedom.
